opening_intro.text:
Mindfulness-Based Stress Reduction (MBSR) & Mindfulness Based Program facilitator, researcher, and mindfulness trainer. Retired Neurologist and Sleep Specialist.
I used to study the brain, but only the brains of others; now I study the mind, gratefully only mine! 
 I used to help other people sleep; now I help us wake up!
